'''Bela Whinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], she was stationed aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Carida (starship)|''Carida'']] when it was [[Attack on the Carida|attacked]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. After the attack, she called on for help for the injured [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Laranna Fain]]. When Fain, overcome by the [[Dark Plague]], attacked her own forces, Whinn requested help from the Jedi Order, and received it from a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]].
